title: Operational Error Compass and Tracehook Onramp for Inference Observability
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Build an 'Operational Error Compass' — a single-pane dashboard and onboarding flow that synthesizes tracehook-derived failure signatures, metric/log pipeline signals, and HTTP/gRPC/model error categories to accelerate triage. The Compass should make the most common inference failure modes (client timeouts, request overload, model decode errors, tokenization/model crashes, and transport errors/HTTP/gRPC codes) explorable by dimension (route, model, region, capacity tier) and include prescriptive next steps and runbook links.

Scope:
- Aggregate enriched tracehook spans into a canonical failure row format (failure_type, root_cause_hint, sample_trace_id, last_seen, frequency, p50/p95 latency impact) and surface in a Grafana canvas.
- Schema mapping for errors coming from: runtime (timeouts, OOMs), router (backpressure/drop), model (generation/decoding errors, safety rejects), and transport (HTTP 4xx/5xx, gRPC status codes).
- Instrument onboarding flow for new services to emit the few required tracehook fields and provide sample queries for metrics/log pipeline (Prometheus, Loki, OTLP traces).
- Alert tuning guidance: when to fire SLO vs operational alert, recommended aggregation windows and sampling rates.

Out of scope: Automated remediation, auto-rollbacks, or full integration with Dedicated autoscaler (follow-up ticket).

Acceptance criteria:
- Canonical failure rows produced in the observability datastore from 90% of production routes within staging region.
- Grafana dashboard with drilldowns by model, route, and node, with sample trace links that open in Trace UI.
- Onboarding doc + checklist and two internal services (router & runtime) complete onboarding steps and linked PRs.

Approach:
1) Define canonical failure row schema and minimal tracehook contract (fields: failure_category, failure_code, node_role, model_variant, prefix_cached, trace_id, span_id, latency_ms, cpu_mem_snapshot). Keep schema flat to ease queries and minimize cardinality where possible.
2) Implement a lightweight tracehook enrichment library (Go/Python) to attach the fields at the point of detection. Library will default to conservative sampling (1%) with an override flag for targeted routes (canary, high-error).
3) Add pipeline transformations in the metrics/log team: OTLP traces -> trace-enrichment kstream -> canonical-failures table (OLAP) -> Grafana. Use existing Kafka topic used by tracehook pipeline (tracehook-events-v2).
4) Build Grafana Canvas: top row summary cards (unique failure types, error rate delta 24h, median latency hit), middle row heatmap (route x failure_type), bottom row recent sample traces and runbook links.
5) Ship onboarding playbook and runbook snippets for triage decisions (timeout vs overload: check inflight / queued metrics; model error: attach model logs + decoder stack; HTTP/gRPC: include status code histogram).

Data & cardinality trade-offs:
- Avoid full request-body capture. Only store small decoding errors & short exception messages (<=512 chars) to keep storage predictable.
- Use normalization for model_variant and route to limit tag explosion. Map ad-hoc route names to canonical resource IDs at ingestion.

Privacy & security: no customer payload, sample-only. Any PII must be redacted by the enrichment library before emission.

Rollout plan: staging -> canary (5% of requests for 48h) -> progressive increase to 30% -> full. Monitor ingestion cost and index size; rollback sampler to 0.5% if storage projection exceeds threshold.

2026-02-25 - Decision: canonical schema finalized. We dropped capturing full exception stack traces to limit cardinality and cost. Chosen fields: failure_category, failure_code, model_variant, route_id, node_role, trace_id, sample_span, latency_ms, timestamp. (Design review: Tamara)

2026-03-01 - Implementation: tracehook lib prototype merged to github.com/redwood-inference/tracehook-lib PR #154. Library defaults to 1% sampling and exposes environment flag TRACEHOOK_SAMPLE_PCT. (PR link in Links) - TODO: add automatic redaction rules for customer IDs.

2026-03-04 - Metrics pipeline: kstream enrichment wired; canonical_failures table created in OLAP cluster. Initial daily size projection: ~12GB/day at 1% sampling across all routes — agreed to monitor for 72h. (Metrics owner: Jin Park)
2026-03-07 - Dashboard: first Grafana draft up at dashboards/operational-error-compass. Need UX tweaks: color palette for heatmap and add hover text for triage steps. (Design review queued)

2026-03-10 - Onboarding: router and runtime teams completed checklist and added tracehook-lib to their sidecars. Canary planned for 2026-03-12. QA: ensure span links open correctly in Trace UI and that sample_trace_id resolves to a retained trace.
